reason: I already have an inverter and battery in the house, so I would rather buy an ordinary semi-automatic for about ₹11,000 and run it on the inverter, or put in a bigger battery that runs the fans and the washer. Paying double for a second battery that only runs the washing machine doesn't make sense to me.
objection: A normal semi-automatic costs about half this, and my inverter can probably already run one. Two cold loads on a charge isn't much for a family, and in 3 or 4 years I'll be paying again for a new lithium battery.
would_change_my_mind: If the dealer showed me that my inverter can't actually handle a washer motor, or if the battery could also run my lights and fans during a cut so it does the inverter's job too, at around ₹15,000.
